home.heroCaptionTitle: Web design and support, close to home.
backgroundBody: Based in Charlevoix the Beautiful, I help businesses turn overwhelming tech challenges into simple, reliable systems. My approach is user experience first, so the complexity stays behind the scenes and the tools feel natural to use.

Over the years, I’ve earned trust across our community, supporting local nonprofits and working with courts across Michigan. Alongside my technical work, I’m also a certified counselor at BASES here in Charlevoix, which deepened my passion for helping people and improving how teams work.

Whether I’m building a custom website or designing an automated hybrid meeting room, the goal stays the same: dependable solutions that reduce friction and make everyday work feel smoother, easier, and more intentional.

faqs.question: Do you only build websites for businesses in Charlevoix?
faqs.answer: No. I am based in Charlevoix and regularly serve businesses throughout Northern Michigan, including Charlevoix, Emmet, Antrim, Cheboygan, and Otsego counties. Remote projects are welcome too.

faqs.question: How much does a small business website cost?
faqs.answer: The standard website package starts at $2,400, with hosting, analytics, monitoring, and unlimited edits available for $100 per month. A final scope is confirmed before work begins.

faqs.question: Is local SEO included?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every build includes the technical and on-page foundations search engines need to understand the business, services, and service area. Rankings also depend on competition, business prominence, links, and an accurate Google Business Profile, so no honest provider can guarantee a particular position.

faqs.question: Can you improve an existing website?
faqs.answer: Yes. I can assess an existing site and recommend whether focused improvements or a rebuild will provide the clearest return.

faqs.question: Will I be able to update the site after launch?
faqs.answer: Yes. The site can be maintained through a content system, or you can send changes through the ongoing support plan and I will handle them for you.

package.title: Start with one costly workflow.

deliverables.title: System synchronization
deliverables.body: Move the right information between separate tools with clear rules, validation, and recovery paths.

deliverables.title: Email automation
deliverables.body: Trigger useful confirmations, notifications, and follow-ups from the events already happening in the business.

deliverables.title: Practical AI assistance
deliverables.body: Use AI for focused tasks where it removes friction while keeping important decisions visible to people.

proof.title: MI Drug Test
proof.body: A live operational workflow keeps information aligned across two separate systems and automates email communication. It is the clearest example of how I approach automation: solve a specific business handoff and make it dependable.

process.title: Find the handoff
process.body: Identify the recurring copy-paste work, missed follow-up, or disconnected system causing the most friction.

process.title: Map the rules
process.body: Define what moves, what triggers it, who should be notified, and where human review still belongs.

process.title: Build and test
process.body: Implement the smallest dependable workflow and test normal, duplicate, and failure scenarios.

process.title: Monitor and refine
process.body: Watch the workflow in production, document it, and improve only where real use shows a need.

aiAutomation.ctaTitle: What manual handoff keeps slowing the business down?
aiAutomation.ctaBody: Bring one real workflow. We can map whether automation is practical before committing to a larger project.
